description:
Recovered signed Project V7 Patcher release after the original semantic-release Git notes push failed.

Includes CNR Compatibility 1.0.9, the verified cooperative-wait ARM64 native host (preserving Shipment MW stability), generic Unity 4.6 compatibility recommendations, and the current pinned CNR managed mod set.

The APK was rebuilt from this exact existing release tag, verified against the known-good CNR native SHA-256, and signed with the established Android and GPG release keys.
